purpose: Twin-tube backbone with clip-on transverse brace at mid-height when deployed, brace unclipped alongside for flat fold; toe folds up, handle slides down
code_or_query:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt; plt.xkcd(); fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(6,4)); ax.set_aspect('equal'); ax.axis('off')
# deployed twin tubes
ax.plot([0,0],[0,3],'k',lw=2); ax.plot([0.4,0.4],[0,3],'k',lw=2)
# brace deployed
ax.plot([0,0.4],[1.5,1.5],'k',lw=3); ax.text(0.2,1.6,'clip brace',fontsize=8,ha='center')
# toe plate
ax.plot([0, -0.8],[0,0],'k',lw=2); ax.text(-0.6,-0.2,'toe',fontsize=8)
# handle
ax.plot([0,0.1],[3,3.8],'k',lw=2); ax.plot([0.4,0.5],[3,3.8],'k',lw=2); ax.text(0.5,3.6,'U-handle',fontsize=8)
ax.text(-0.9,2.5,'deployed\nbraced',fontsize=9)
# folded side
ax.plot([2,2],[0.5,2.2],'k',lw=2); ax.plot([2.4,2.4],[0.5,2.2],'k',lw=2)
ax.plot([2,2.4],[1.2,1.2],'k:',lw=2); ax.text(2.2,1.35,'brace\nstowed',fontsize=7,ha='center')
ax.plot([2,1.6],[0.5,0.5],'k',lw=2); ax.text(1.4,0.35,'toe folded up',fontsize=7)
ax.text(1.7,2.5,'folded flat',fontsize=9)
plt.savefig('sketch.png',dpi=150,bbox_inches='tight')
